conbody.p: The Rear Occupant Alert (ROA) is provided to help prevent exiting the vehicle with a rear passenger left in the vehicle.

section.title: Simple operation

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleConvenienceRear Occupant Alert on the infotainment system screen.

section.p: For detailed information, refer to Navigation Quick Reference Guide.

section.title: Operation

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleConvenienceRear Occupant Alert on the infotainment system screen.

section.p: For detailed information, refer to Navigation Quick Reference Guide.

section.title: 1st alert operation

entry.p: (A) Do not leave children or pets alone. Detection starts after locking vehicle.

section.p: When the rear passenger door has been opened and closed, and you turn off the vehicle and open the driver’s door after driving, a warning message appears on the cluster.

section.title: 2nd alert operation
section.p: After the first alert, the second alert operates when any movement is detected in the vehicle after the driver’s door is closed and all the doors are locked. The horn will sound for approximately 25 seconds. Also, a text message is sent once to members of Kia Connect Services (if equipped). If the system continues to detect a movement, the alert operates up to 8 times at regular intervals. Unlock the doors with the smart key to stop the alert.
The system detects movement in the vehicle for a certain period of time after the door is locked.
